notes.title: May 8th Update Notes
notes.notes:
1.对角色添加了浮动动画,使得御剑飞行的效果更好.
2.减少了阳天的怪物数量成长系数.进一步减少了阳天难度.
3.减少了玄天的怪物数量成长系数,以减少最后阶段卡顿.

notes.title: May 6th Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Added cloud archive function.
2. Added steam achievement system. And added 37 achievements.

notes.title: May 5th Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Optimized some UI to make it display better when localized to English.
2. Added volume saving function. Now after starting the game, the volume setting will be set to the setting when you last exited.

notes.title: May 4th Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that the protagonist's speed is abnormal when the screen is stuck.
2. Extended the width of the appearance details display box to make some localized languages ​​display better.
3. Increased the number of upgrade tabs that can be displayed per line in the skill upgrade interface.
4. Reduced the font size of the initial skill title.
5. Canceled the title display of the skill card in the field.
6. Reduced the number of monsters in Yangtian.
7. Fixed some translation issues.
8. Fixed the bug that the character speed is abnormal when NVIDIA sets the image to performance instead of quality.

notes.title: May 3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Further reduced the number of damage numbers.
2. Enhanced the Ten Sun Flying Swords, Four Flying Swords Straight, Four Flying Swords Oblique, and increased their initial penetration by 1.
3. Optimized the appearance details display box so that it can adapt to the size according to the description content.
3. Optimized the content talent tree, node details display box so that it can adapt to the size according to the description content.

notes.title: 5月2日更新说明
notes.notes:
1.修复了初始技能被点击播放选择动画的bug.
2.用对象池技术优化了突破技能,减少了游戏的卡顿情况.
3.修复了经验球不能被完全销毁的bug.

notes.title: 4月29日更新说明
notes.notes:
1.增加了地图机制的刷新距离
2.更改了所有场景的环境预设方案,减少了画面模糊
3.加强了劈瓜神斧,使其初始穿透增加1

notes.title: 4月26日更新说明
notes.notes:
1.修改了部分内容天赋树天赋点的业力消耗.
2.修复了部分音效音量无法控制的问题.
3.修复了部分翻译不全的问题.
